name: Environment / infra
description: Target unavailable, hanging or reset (5xx, network, request still pending at test timeout, shared-demo DB reset). Not a product verdict; rerun when the target is healthy.
messageRegex: [\s\S]*(env-unavailable|HTTP 5\d\d|Something went wrong|selected product id is invalid|ECONNREFUSED|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|ENOTFOUND|EAI_AGAIN|socket hang up|Request context disposed)[\s\S]*

name: Test defect
description: Bug in the test code, fixture or data setup (setup: failures, JS errors, timeouts).
messageRegex: [\s\S]*(setup: |TypeError|ReferenceError|SyntaxError|is not a function|Cannot read properties|Test timeout|Timeout \d+ms exceeded|fixture)[\s\S]*

name: Product defect
description: Assertion failed against a healthy target: wrong status, body or schema.
